subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` passthrough, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta`/`context1m` option, or no user-configurable beta flags?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but any fix adds a user-facing Bedrock provider config contract and repository policy treats provider routing and config surfaces as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
options.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that validates and merges request fields, covering `anthropic_beta` without making core own generic Bedrock payload policy.

options.title: Add only typed beta support
options.body: Support a narrow `anthropicBeta` or Bedrock `context1m` path for Claude long-context usage while avoiding a general Converse body passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom betas
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and require first-class provider support for each beta feature before OpenClaw sends it.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that validates and merges request fields, covering `anthropic_beta` without making core own generic Bedrock payload policy.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans provider config policy, Bedrock plugin boundaries, and adjacent Claude long-context support where this owner has recent merged history.
